name: Hekigan no Soukishi Feril to Ririka
original_name: 碧眼の双騎士フェリルとリリカ
source:
The main character is the boss of an evil group. He has just destroyed all the elf tribes and is now trying to attack the human tribes. But there are Feril and Ririka, who are survived elves, in one of the human tribes and they counterattack to take revenge on them. After a long battle, he successfully captures Feril and Ririka.... But he gets injured at the same time. To cure it, he needs hi-quality energy. The main character transforms himself into a monster and sexually assaults the two elves. As they are raped by ugly monsters one by one, they gradually get addicted to it....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主人公是邪恶集团首领，刚刚消灭了所有精灵部族，如今准备向人类部族发起进攻。然而某个人类部族中生活着幸存精灵菲莉尔与莉莉卡，她们为复仇展开反击。经过漫长战斗，主人公终于成功俘获二人…自己却也身受重伤。若想治愈伤势，他需要高质量能量。主人公化身怪物，对两名精灵实施性侵。随着她们接连遭到丑陋怪物强奸，竟渐渐沉迷其中…
